title: Tidebreak — island boat run
pitch: A weighty little launch, three coastal gates, and a quiet return to the jetty.

authorization.basis: User executes PROMPT.md and explicitly requests a dedicated worktree; launch prompt delegates routine design, dependency installation, tests, local commits and bounded agents including independent critic.

mustHave: One roughly 160 m island, finite 520 × 520 m navigable bounds, dry land and coast collisions
Game-owned momentum boat, chase camera, wake, ordered three-gate swept crossing and gentle docking below 0.8 m/s
Start/pause/resume/result/retry/reset and cleared input on blur
Five useful graphics controls and owned promoted water reflection lifecycle
Real keyboard complete lap and correctness checks; source/license receipts preserved
outOfScope: Walking, AI, upgrades, weather, physics solver

milestones.title: Complete integrated boat lap
deliverables: Owned starter fork, boat dynamics, rules, island/ocean, camera and UI
acceptance: Real input completes ordered lap and gentle docking, then retry
No coast penetration, collision recovery, pause clears input, out-of-order gates reject

milestones.title: Validation and bounded independent art review
deliverables: Committed source, current README, local critic captures
acceptance: Art review stops at 8/10 or four rounds with honest result

lanes.role: Integrates renderer, ocean/island, camera, presentation; owns source, serial browser/GPU lane and commits

playthrough: Start, throttle and steer through all gates with real keyboard; dock below 0.8 m/s; result and retry
Reverse/recovery, shore/rock/dock collision, wrong/missed gate rejection, pause/blur held throttle, reset
Production test hooks absent; graphics and narrow layout

stopAfter: Verified playable handoff after independent critic passes or four rounds; no depth without user feedback.
